# Maadhav V H

> AI/ML engineer from Coimbatore building small LLMs, vision and RAG systems that run on-device, on phone NPUs and Arm boards. SEMICON India 2026 runner-up.

hey, i'm maadhav. i build ml systems — small llms, vision models, rag — and get them running on real hardware: phone npus, arm boards, a car's own signals. studying ece at kpriet, coimbatore. when i'm not in class, i'm usually at a hackathon finale somewhere in india.

Role: ai / ml engineer · on-device ai. Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Site: https://vhmaadhav.com/

## Projects
- VehicleGPT: Ask a car about its own data: a 1B-parameter model answering from CAN logs, fully offline. Proof: accuracy 29.5% → 95.5% · 1.7 s on 2 cores / 2 GiB.
- Rakshak-Edge: Catches scam SMS and links on an Arm device, offline — and refuses to give explanations it can't back up. Proof: on-device · adversarially tested.
- Mouna: Speak by mouthing words — silent lip-reading turned into voice on a phone's NPU, no internet. Proof: false utterances 23% → 7% · Kannada top-1 75.3%.
- [DriftSense](https://github.com/vhmaadhav/semicon-driftsense): Finds where a wafer-inspection microscope actually is — even when zoom and rotation are unknown, or the pattern isn't there. Proof: F1 0.91 · sub-pixel CAD-to-SEM registration.
- Axiom Trace: A tutor that knows what you know: knowledge-graph RAG with mastery tracking and animated ECE explanations. Proof: Next.js + Kotlin · 176 tests.
- DT Guardian: Keeps a neighbourhood transformer from overheating by scheduling batteries, EV chargers and pumps at the edge. Proof: −53% essential energy lost in an outage simulation.
- Also on GitHub: [embeddinggemma-mobile-benchmark](https://github.com/vhmaadhav/embeddinggemma-mobile-benchmark), [hiver-email-suggested-response](https://github.com/vhmaadhav/hiver-email-suggested-response)
